acknowledgement.intro: It has been a true pleasure to be a part of MSME Competitive (Lean) Scheme (GOE/MCLS/QCI/MH-213) as a Lean Manufacturing Consultant. Overall, it has been a mutually value adding program and we believe that we too have learnt some things under this program.

msmeThanks.pre: We express our heartfelt gratitude towards,
lines: MSME DI team for their support and coordination throughout the program.
QCI Team Members for their constant support & coordination throughout the program.

acknowledgement.auditorThanks: Our thanks to auditors from QCI, QCI-appointed auditors, for their valuable guidance and points for improvement.
acknowledgement.unitThanksPre: This program wouldn't have been successful without the cooperation, involvement and support from the unit owners & their teams. We thank,
acknowledgement.closingLine: We also thank Lean Coordinators of all the units and Lean team members for their active involvement & participation to make this program successful.
acknowledgement.signOff: Mr. Parvat Gangurde & Team at AB Associates

testimonial: We, Idea Tools, sincerely thank the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME), Government of India, the Quality Council of India (QCI), and the Lean Manufacturing Consultant, Mr. Parvat Gangurde and his team from AB Associates, for their valuable guidance and support during the implementation of Lean Manufacturing Practices under the MCLS scheme.

Our unit is engaged in the manufacture of Tools and dies, Jig's and fixtures, with core processes including Die Manufacturing. The Lean journey has provided a structured approach to strengthen workplace practices, standardisation and continuous improvement around these operations. The focus is to sustain disciplined practices and use systematic problem-solving to improve operational performance.
We remain committed to sustaining these improvements and progressing toward the Advanced Stage of Lean Implementation for long-term operational excellence.
observations: Idea Tools is engaged in the manufacture of Tools and dies, Jig's and fixtures, with the key manufacturing process identified as Die Manufacturing. The unit profile indicates a process-oriented manufacturing setup where systematic control and standardisation can support consistent performance.

Based on the available unit information, the Lean implementation is positioned around practical shop-floor improvement, including 5S, Kaizen and Daily Work Management. For the reported product and process family, continued focus on standard work, visual controls, workplace organisation and data-based problem solving will help sustain the improvements and support further Lean maturity.
recommendationsIntro: Idea Tools has laid a solid foundation in lean manufacturing and now stands at a promising inflection point to deepen its transformation.

recommendations.title: SMED
recommendations.body: Faster die/tool changeovers will reduce setup time and support smaller batch sizes.

recommendations.title: Advanced 5S and Visual Management
recommendations.body: More sophisticated visual controls and layered audits will further reduce searching time and minor delays.

recommendations.title: 7 QC Tools
recommendations.body: Data-based problem solving will help identify and reduce recurring defects systematically.

recommendationsClosing: Overall, the unit exhibits strong potential to adopt advanced lean tools and systems, and is well-positioned to achieve sustained excellence and competitive advantage.
